in_marathi.name: Hardik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong, Powerful, Intelligent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hardik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'hardas' which means 'strong' or 'powerful'. The name Hardik is also considered to be an abbreviated form of the name Haridhara, which is a combination of 'hari' (God Vishnu) and 'dhara' (supporter or sustainer). In Hindu mythology, Hardik is believed to represent strength, power, and intelligence.
